title: Talk it through 2.1
role: Team member talking with a colleague about a change at work and how it feels
can_do: I can talk about a change at work and how I feel about it.
I can weigh advantages and disadvantages with on the one hand and on the other hand.

nodes.partner_line: Have you heard? The company is going to merge two departments.
nodes.translation: ¿Te enteraste? La empresa va a fusionar dos departamentos.

options.text: Yes, and honestly I feel a little anxious about it.
I did hear. I am not sure how I feel yet.
Really? That is quite a surprise.

nodes.partner_line: How do you feel about the change?
nodes.model_reply: I feel nervous, but also a little excited.

nodes.translation: ¿Qué es lo que más te preocupa?

options.text: The workload. We are already stretched thin.
Losing the people I work well with.
Not knowing who my new manager will be.

nodes.partner_line: Is there anything positive about it?

options.text: On the one hand it is risky; on the other hand, it could open doors.
Yes. Although it is stressful, we may learn new skills.
Possibly. We will have more resources, even though the transition will be hard.

nodes.partner_line: How are you going to adapt?

options.text: I will take things one step at a time.
I am going to talk to my team before deciding anything.
I plan to ask for training in the new system.

nodes.partner_line: Good idea. Shall we talk again next week?
nodes.translation: Buena idea. ¿Hablamos de nuevo la próxima semana?

options.text: Yes, please. It really helps to talk it through.
Sure. Let us have coffee on Monday.
